changes: Removed generic AddToken and CaptureDirectory alternatives from messaging-credential routine signatures; specific Discord and Telegram routine names remain.
Moved ClientInfo literal/name evidence and UPLOAD/DOWNLOAD pipe fragments out of communications capabilities into neutral naming/syntax observations.

Removed EXECUTE/KILLPROCESS words from Delf family identification. Their IRC consumer now requires both distinct process-control command words plus protocol evidence, and describes a suspicious command set without asserting executed process control.
Moved MemoryModule name evidence out of Pupy family identification into shared-library name references.
Moved the VirtualProtect import observation from a metadata profile to memory-protection capabilities and updated consumers.
C# module initializer detection uses parsed attributes, handles qualified names and the Attribute suffix, and excludes comments and string examples.

Added parsed PowerShell PnPUtil add-driver and update-device operations, including call-operator invocations. Call facts currently omit the target for & invocations; structural queries bind tool and argument to the same parsed command.
Added actual managed-call observations for RuntimeMethodHandle.GetFunctionPointer and Debugger.get_IsAttached; these remain neutral and do not assert method patching or anti-debugging intent.
Timestamp descriptions now state numeric field ranges rather than asserting compile dates; shortened descriptions and removed duplicated defaults encountered in the previous review.
